quotes.quote: No words: the mother puts the box on the floor and leaves the room.
quotes.note: A moment, not a line: the present is a surprise, and the box is moving.

truefalse.s: The puppy has three legs.
The boy is happy to see the puppy's three legs.
truefalse.fix: He is angry, and he does not want the puppy near him.

truefalse.s: The ball is red.
The puppy stops trying to play.
truefalse.fix: The puppy keeps trying and brings the ball again and again.

truefalse.s: The boy has one leg.
The boy stays inside at the end.
truefalse.fix: He takes his crutches and goes outside to play.

shortAnswers.q: Why is the boy angry at the puppy?
shortAnswers.model: The puppy has three legs like him, and he does not want to see that.

shortAnswers.q: Why does the puppy keep getting up?
shortAnswers.model: He wants to play with the boy, so he never stops trying.

shortAnswers.q: What does the boy learn from the puppy?
shortAnswers.model: He learns that he can still play and be happy with one leg.

shortAnswers.q: How do you feel at the end of the film?
shortAnswers.model: I feel happy because the boy and the puppy go outside together.
